ex.zh: 「走路到維也納要多久？」他問。

ex.zh: 我打電話來詢問這個職缺。

ex.zh: 這個社區安全嗎？晚上有照明設施嗎？

ex.zh: 美術館正在展出一件新的裝置藝術。

ex.zh: 講師教我們如何使用這套軟體。

ex.zh: 雖然她經驗不足，卻把客戶處理得很好。

ex.zh: 你知道這附近有便宜的旅館嗎？

ex.zh: 大家都說這家餐廳的菜又好吃又便宜。

ex.zh: 這是一篇內容很充實的文章。

ex.zh: 語言是人類最重要的發明之一。

incremental.zh: 逐步增加的、漸進的；額外增加的

ex.en: We made incremental improvements to the product.
ex.zh: 我們對產品做了漸進式的改良。

ex.en: Incremental changes are easier to manage.
ex.zh: 逐步的改變比較容易管理。

ex.en: The new service brought in incremental revenue.
ex.zh: 新服務帶來了額外營收。

ex.en: She is a woman of great integrity.
ex.zh: 她是非常正直的人。

ex.en: Integrity is important in business.
ex.zh: 誠信在商場上很重要。

ex.en: The software checks the integrity of the data.
ex.zh: 軟體會檢查資料的完整性。

ex.en: The building's structural integrity was tested.
ex.zh: 這棟建築的結構安全經過檢測。

ex.en: In addition, coincidences inevitably come in threes.
ex.zh: 此外，巧合總是接二連三地發生。

ex.en: Prices will inevitably rise.
ex.zh: 物價必然會上漲。

ex.en: Inevitably, some customers were unhappy.
ex.zh: 難免有些顧客不滿意。

info.zh: 資訊、資料（information 的口語縮寫）

ex.en: John kept gathering info.
ex.zh: 約翰一直在蒐集資訊。

ex.en: For more info, visit our website.
ex.zh: 想了解更多資訊，請上我們的網站。

ex.en: The certificate of incorporation was issued last week.
ex.zh: 公司設立登記證明上週核發了。

ex.en: The incorporation of the company took a month.
ex.zh: 公司登記花了一個月。

ex.en: The incorporation of user feedback improved the design.
ex.zh: 納入使用者回饋讓設計變得更好。

ex.en: We discussed the incorporation of new features.
ex.zh: 我們討論了加入新功能的事。

ex.en: Insect invasions can destroy entire crops.
ex.zh: 蟲害入侵可能毀掉整片農作物。

ex.en: The island has a long history of foreign invasion.
ex.zh: 這座島長期遭受外來侵略。

ex.en: Reading my messages is an invasion of privacy.
ex.zh: 看我的訊息是侵犯隱私。

ex.en: Customers see such calls as an invasion of their privacy.
ex.zh: 顧客認為這種電話侵犯了他們的隱私。

ex.en: The job's intrinsic rewards matter more to me than money.
ex.zh: 對我來說，這份工作本身帶來的成就感比錢更重要。

ex.en: Trust is intrinsic to a good relationship.
ex.zh: 信任是良好關係的根本。

ex.en: You should interact with the local culture more, to better understand some traditions.
ex.zh: 你應該多接觸當地文化，才能更了解一些傳統。

ex.en: The app lets users interact with each other in real time.
ex.zh: 這個 App 讓使用者能即時互動。

ex.en: Our teacher encourages us to interact in English.
ex.zh: 老師鼓勵我們用英文交流。

ex.en: Some medicines can interact with alcohol.
ex.zh: 有些藥物會和酒精產生交互作用。

ex.en: We are studying how these two chemicals interact.
ex.zh: 我們正在研究這兩種化學物質如何相互作用。

ex.en: We must intervene.
ex.zh: 我們必須介入。

ex.en: The manager had to intervene in the argument between two staff members.
ex.zh: 經理不得不出面調停兩位員工的爭執。

ex.en: The central bank may intervene to stabilize the currency.
ex.zh: 央行可能會進場干預以穩定匯率。

inherent.zh: 固有的、內在的、與生俱來的

ex.en: She has inherent dignity.
ex.zh: 她有與生俱來的尊嚴。

ex.en: We must never forget the inherent value of every human being.
ex.zh: 我們絕不能忘記每個人與生俱來的價值。

ex.en: Every investment has some inherent risk.
ex.zh: 每一項投資都有其固有的風險。

ex.en: The parking space is inadequate for so many visitors.
ex.zh: 停車位不夠容納這麼多訪客。

ex.en: His salary is inadequate to support his family.
ex.zh: 他的薪水不足以養家。

inadequate.zh: （覺得自己）能力不足的、不稱職的

ex.en: I felt inadequate compared to my talented colleagues.
ex.zh: 和能幹的同事相比，我覺得自己能力不足。

ex.en: Nobody should be made to feel inadequate at work.
ex.zh: 不該讓任何人在工作上覺得自己不夠好。

ex.en: The new product was an instant success.
ex.zh: 新產品一推出就大獲成功。

ex.en: Online banking gives you instant access to your account.
ex.zh: 網路銀行讓你隨時可以查看帳戶。

ex.en: I had instant noodles as a midnight snack.
ex.zh: 我宵夜吃了泡麵。

ex.en: If you drink instant coffee you do not need a coffee pot.
ex.zh: 如果你喝即溶咖啡，就不需要咖啡壺。

ex.en: Right at that instant, the bus stopped.
ex.zh: 就在那一刻，公車停了下來。

ex.en: I'll be back in an instant.
ex.zh: 我馬上回來。

ex.en: The new law will indirectly affect small businesses.
ex.zh: 新法會間接影響到小型企業。

ex.en: She indirectly suggested that I should leave.
ex.zh: 她拐彎抹角地暗示我該走了。

ex.en: She learned to work independently.
ex.zh: 她學會了獨立作業。

ex.en: Each team works independently.
ex.zh: 每個團隊各自獨立運作。

independently.zh: 各自分別地；由第三方（獨立）

ex.en: Two scientists made the same discovery independently.
ex.zh: 兩位科學家各自獨立地有了相同的發現。

ex.en: The results were independently verified.
ex.zh: 這些結果經過第三方獨立驗證。

ex.en: My level in English is intermediate.
ex.zh: 我的英文程度是中級。

ex.en: This course is designed for intermediate learners.
ex.zh: 這門課是為中級程度的學習者設計的。

ex.en: There are several intermediate steps in the process.
ex.zh: 這個流程中間還有好幾個步驟。

ex.en: The product goes through an intermediate stage before packaging.
ex.zh: 產品在包裝前會經過一個中間階段。

ex.en: John inherited a large fortune.
ex.zh: 約翰繼承了一大筆財產。

ex.en: What did Tom inherit?
ex.zh: 湯姆繼承了什麼？

inherit.zh: 遺傳；接手（前任留下的事物）

ex.en: She inherited her mother's blue eyes.
ex.zh: 她遺傳了媽媽的藍眼睛。

ex.en: The new manager inherited many problems from his predecessor.
ex.zh: 新經理從前任那裡接手了許多問題。

ex.en: Is Tom infected?
ex.zh: 湯姆被感染了嗎？

ex.en: He got infected with HIV.
ex.zh: 他感染了愛滋病毒。

ex.en: When the wound got infected, he experienced a bout of unbearable pain.
ex.zh: 傷口感染後，他痛得難以忍受。

ex.en: My computer has been infected with BraveSentry.
ex.zh: 我的電腦中了 BraveSentry 病毒。

ex.en: Don't open that file; it could infect your computer.
ex.zh: 別開那個檔案，它可能會讓你的電腦中毒。

inflationary.zh: 通貨膨脹的、造成通膨的

ex.en: Rising oil prices put inflationary pressure on the economy.
ex.zh: 油價上漲對經濟帶來通膨壓力。

ex.en: The central bank is worried about inflationary risks.
ex.zh: 央行擔心通膨風險。

ex.en: We welcome the inclusion of two new members.
ex.zh: 我們歡迎兩位新成員加入。

ex.en: His inclusion in the team surprised everyone.
ex.zh: 他入選隊伍讓大家都很意外。

ex.en: The company promotes diversity and inclusion.
ex.zh: 公司提倡多元與包容。

ex.en: Inclusion means making everyone feel welcome.
ex.zh: 包容就是讓每個人都感到被接納。

ex.en: I won't allow you to continue your interference in my daughter's life.
ex.zh: 我不會再容許你干涉我女兒的生活。

ex.en: The company rejected any government interference in its business.
ex.zh: 這家公司拒絕政府對其業務的任何干預。

ex.en: The radio signal suffered from interference.
ex.zh: 無線電訊號受到干擾。

ex.en: Mobile phones may cause interference with medical equipment.
ex.zh: 手機可能會干擾醫療設備。

ex.en: She assumed an air of indifference.
ex.zh: 她裝出一副不在乎的樣子。

ex.en: He doesn't have the indifference typical of people from big cities.
ex.zh: 他沒有大城市人常見的那種冷漠。

ex.en: The manager's indifference to customer complaints hurt sales.
ex.zh: 經理對客訴漠不關心，影響了業績。

ex.en: Government forces captured several insurgents.
ex.zh: 政府軍逮捕了幾名叛亂分子。

ex.en: The insurgents controlled the northern region.
ex.zh: 叛亂分子控制了北部地區。

ex.en: Political instability has hurt the economy.
ex.zh: 政治動盪傷害了經濟。

ex.en: Market instability makes investors nervous.
ex.zh: 市場不穩定讓投資人很緊張。

ex.en: The position will be filled internally.
ex.zh: 這個職缺會由內部人員遞補。

ex.en: The problem was handled internally.
ex.zh: 這個問題在內部處理掉了。

ex.en: The intensity of the storm surprised everyone.
ex.zh: 暴風雨的強度讓大家都很驚訝。

ex.en: She works with great intensity.
ex.zh: 她工作非常投入、全力以赴。

ex.en: The Romans invaded Britain about 2,000 years ago.
ex.zh: 羅馬人大約在兩千年前入侵英國。

ex.en: Ants invaded our kitchen last summer.
ex.zh: 去年夏天螞蟻大舉入侵我們的廚房。

ex.en: This app invades users' privacy.
ex.zh: 這個 App 侵犯使用者的隱私。

ex.en: I don't want to invade your privacy.
ex.zh: 我不想侵犯你的隱私。

ex.en: I need to give you an injection.
ex.zh: 我得幫你打一針。

ex.en: I'll give you a painkilling injection.
ex.zh: 我幫你打一針止痛針。

ex.en: The company received a cash injection from investors.
ex.zh: 公司獲得了投資人的資金挹注。

ex.en: The economy needs an injection of new money.
ex.zh: 經濟需要注入新的資金。

ex.en: The government is struggling to end the insurgency.
ex.zh: 政府正努力平息叛亂。

ex.en: The insurgency began five years ago.
ex.zh: 這場叛亂始於五年前。

incline.zh: 傾向於（常用 be inclined to）

ex.en: I'm inclined to agree with you.
ex.zh: 我傾向同意你的看法。

ex.en: Customers are more inclined to buy when prices drop.
ex.zh: 價格下降時，顧客比較願意購買。

ex.en: The car rolled down the incline.
ex.zh: 車子沿著斜坡滑了下去。

ex.en: Walking up a steep incline is good exercise.
ex.zh: 走陡坡是很好的運動。

ex.en: Excessive choice results in the inability to choose.
ex.zh: 選擇太多反而讓人無法選擇。

ex.en: Superstitions derive from the inability of men to acknowledge that coincidences are merely coincidences.
ex.zh: 迷信源自人們無法接受巧合就只是巧合。

ex.en: The report pointed out several inefficiencies in the system.
ex.zh: 報告指出系統中幾個效率不彰的地方。

ex.en: Inefficiency costs the company millions every year.
ex.zh: 效率低落每年讓公司損失數百萬。

ex.en: She hired a private investigator.
ex.zh: 她請了一位私家偵探。

ex.en: He's a seasoned investigator.
ex.zh: 他是一位經驗豐富的調查員。

ex.en: Investigators are looking into the cause of the fire.
ex.zh: 調查人員正在調查起火原因。

ex.en: The new policy proved ineffective.
ex.zh: 新政策證實沒有效果。

ex.en: Antibiotics are ineffective against viruses.
ex.zh: 抗生素對病毒無效。

ex.en: Foreign people intrigue me.
ex.zh: 我對外國人很好奇。

ex.en: That is intriguing.
ex.zh: 那真耐人尋味。

ex.en: The idea really intrigued me.
ex.zh: 這個點子讓我很感興趣。

ex.en: The novel is full of political intrigue.
ex.zh: 這本小說充滿了政治陰謀。

ex.en: There is a lot of office intrigue at that company.
ex.zh: 那家公司的辦公室鬥爭很多。

ex.en: Jack is the most intelligent boy in the class.
ex.zh: 傑克是班上最聰明的男孩。

ex.en: The dolphin is a very intelligent animal.
ex.zh: 海豚是非常聰明的動物。

ex.en: He is not as intelligent as his older brother.
ex.zh: 他沒有他哥哥那麼聰明。

ex.en: The car has an intelligent parking system.
ex.zh: 這輛車配備智慧停車系統。

ex.en: Intelligent software can sort your emails automatically.
ex.zh: 智慧型軟體可以自動整理你的電子郵件。

ex.en: Strictly speaking, this sentence is grammatically incorrect.
ex.zh: 嚴格來說，這個句子的文法不正確。

ex.en: Cross out the incorrect words.
ex.zh: 把錯誤的字劃掉。

ex.en: This is incorrect.
ex.zh: 這是錯的。

ex.en: Most animals have an instinct to protect their young.
ex.zh: 大多數動物都有保護幼獸的本能。

ex.en: Animals act on instinct.
ex.zh: 動物依本能行動。

ex.en: My first instinct was to say no.
ex.zh: 我的第一個直覺是拒絕。

ex.en: She followed her instincts and took the job.
ex.zh: 她相信自己的直覺，接下了那份工作。

ex.en: His story was inconsistent with the evidence.
ex.zh: 他的說詞與證據不符。

ex.en: Your statements today are inconsistent with what you said yesterday.
ex.zh: 你今天的說法和昨天說的前後矛盾。

inconsistent.zh: （表現、品質）不穩定的、時好時壞的

ex.en: The team's performance has been inconsistent this season.
ex.zh: 這支球隊本季表現時好時壞。

ex.en: The service at that restaurant is very inconsistent.
ex.zh: 那家餐廳的服務品質很不穩定。

ex.en: Police intercepted the truck at the border.
ex.zh: 警方在邊境攔截了那輛卡車。

ex.en: The goalkeeper intercepted the pass.
ex.zh: 守門員攔截了那記傳球。

ex.en: Hackers can intercept data sent over public Wi-Fi.
ex.zh: 駭客可以攔截透過公共 Wi-Fi 傳送的資料。

ex.en: The storm is expected to intensify overnight.
ex.zh: 暴風雨預計在夜間增強。

ex.en: The company intensified its marketing efforts.
ex.zh: 公司加強了行銷力道。

ex.en: Paris is the most beautiful city in the world.
ex.zh: 巴黎是世界上最美麗的城市。

ex.en: The files are in the top drawer.
ex.zh: 檔案在最上面的抽屜裡。

in.zh: 在（年、月、季節、上午等時段）

ex.en: I was born in 1995.
ex.zh: 我是一九九五年出生的。

ex.en: We usually go skiing in winter.
ex.zh: 我們通常冬天去滑雪。

ex.en: I'll be back in ten minutes.
ex.zh: 我十分鐘後回來。

ex.en: The package will arrive in three days.
ex.zh: 包裹三天後會到。

ex.en: Please fill out the form in English.
ex.zh: 請用英文填寫表格。

ex.en: Can I pay in cash?
ex.zh: 我可以用現金付款嗎？

ex.en: Is Mr. Chen in today?
ex.zh: 陳先生今天在嗎？

ex.en: Come in, please.
ex.zh: 請進。

ex.en: Are the water and electricity included in the rent?
ex.zh: 房租有包含水電費嗎？

ex.en: Possible side effects include blurred vision and shortness of breath.
ex.zh: 可能的副作用包括視力模糊和呼吸急促。

ex.en: At this language centre, about 15 international languages are taught, including English.
ex.zh: 這個語言中心教授約十五種國際語言，包括英文。

ex.en: He is included among my friends.
ex.zh: 他也是我的朋友之一。

ex.en: Please include me in the email.
ex.zh: 請把我加進這封信的收件人。

ex.en: Tom doesn't care about protecting his personal information online.
ex.zh: 湯姆不在意在網路上保護自己的個資。

ex.en: The Internet is an invaluable source of information.
ex.zh: 網路是非常寶貴的資訊來源。

ex.en: We may combine your personal information with other information.
ex.zh: 我們可能會將你的個人資訊與其他資訊結合。

ex.en: Ask at the information desk.
ex.zh: 去服務台問問看。

ex.en: The information counter is near the entrance.
ex.zh: 詢問處在入口附近。

ex.en: Mastering a foreign language involves a lot of patience.
ex.zh: 學好外語需要很大的耐心。

ex.en: Whichever way we choose will involve danger.
ex.zh: 不管我們選哪條路，都會有危險。

ex.en: Astronomy involves the study of stars and planets.
ex.zh: 天文學包括對恆星和行星的研究。

ex.en: I don't want to be involved in this affair.
ex.zh: 我不想捲入這件事。

ex.en: How many people are involved in the project?
ex.zh: 有多少人參與這個專案？

ex.en: The community is made up of individuals.
ex.zh: 社會是由個人組成的。

ex.en: We are currently looking for individuals who have experience in customer service.
ex.zh: 我們目前正在尋找有客服經驗的人才。

ex.en: Don't generalize individual behavior to an entire group.
ex.zh: 不要把個人行為套用到整個群體。

ex.en: Individual freedom is the soul of democracy.
ex.zh: 個人自由是民主的靈魂。

ex.en: Each student gets individual attention.
ex.zh: 每位學生都能得到個別的關注。

ex.en: I may give up soon and just nap instead.
ex.zh: 我可能很快就會放棄，改去睡個午覺。

ex.en: There was no tea, so I had coffee instead.
ex.zh: 沒有茶了，所以我改喝咖啡。

ex.en: I usually use a credit card instead of cash.
ex.zh: 我通常用信用卡，而不是現金。

ex.en: She's vegetarian, so she ate tofu instead of turkey.
ex.zh: 她吃素，所以她沒吃火雞，而是吃豆腐。

ex.en: Will you go to the party instead of me?
ex.zh: 你可以代替我去派對嗎？

ex.en: Inside the room there is a smell of smoke.
ex.zh: 房間裡有一股煙味。

ex.en: Please wait inside the building.
ex.zh: 請在大樓裡面等候。

ex.en: I want to see what there is inside.
ex.zh: 我想看看裡面有什麼。

ex.en: It's raining, so let's stay inside.
ex.zh: 下雨了，我們待在室內吧。

ex.en: Iron the inside of collars first, and then the outside.
ex.zh: 先燙衣領的內側，再燙外側。

ex.en: The inside of the box was empty.
ex.zh: 箱子裡面是空的。

ex.en: He took out the wallet from his inside jacket pocket.
ex.zh: 他從外套內袋拿出皮夾。

ex.en: The police think it was an inside job.
ex.zh: 警方認為這是內賊所為。

ex.en: He is an interpreter in an international bank.
ex.zh: 他在一家國際銀行當口譯員。

ex.en: International problems must be solved by diplomacy, not war.
ex.zh: 國際問題必須透過外交而非戰爭解決。

ex.en: Taoyuan International Airport is very busy.
ex.zh: 桃園國際機場非常繁忙。

ex.en: Many TV programs have a bad influence on children.
ex.zh: 許多電視節目對兒童有不良影響。

ex.en: He has a strong influence over the business world.
ex.zh: 他在商界很有影響力。

ex.en: I think that our living together has influenced your habits.
ex.zh: 我覺得我們住在一起影響了你的習慣。

ex.en: Price strongly influences what customers buy.
ex.zh: 價格大大影響顧客買什麼。

indeed.zh: 的確、確實；（加強語氣）真的

ex.en: It may, indeed, be a mistake.
ex.zh: 這可能確實是個錯誤。

ex.en: Indeed she is young and beautiful, but she is in delicate health.
ex.zh: 她確實年輕貌美，但身體很虛弱。

ex.en: I'm very well indeed, thank you.
ex.zh: 我真的很好，謝謝您。

ex.en: The strong wind indicates that a storm is coming.
ex.zh: 強風表示暴風雨就要來了。

ex.en: Her smile indicates that she has forgiven me.
ex.zh: 她的微笑表示她已經原諒我了。

ex.en: The survey indicates that customers want lower prices.
ex.zh: 調查顯示顧客希望價格更低。

ex.en: The contents of the box are indicated on the label.
ex.zh: 箱子裡裝什麼都標示在標籤上。

ex.en: The different colored strings indicate different fillings.
ex.zh: 不同顏色的繩子代表不同的餡料。

ex.en: The red flag indicated the presence of danger.
ex.zh: 紅旗表示有危險。

ex.en: Some fruits, for instance oranges, are rich in vitamin C.
ex.zh: 有些水果，例如柳橙，富含維生素 C。

ex.en: We could, for instance, hold the meeting online.

ex.zh: 玩了一個小時我就對那個遊戲沒興趣了。

ex.en: Banks charge higher interest on loans to risky customers.
ex.zh: 銀行對高風險客戶的貸款收取較高的利息。

ex.en: This savings account pays 2% interest.
ex.zh: 這個儲蓄帳戶的利息是 2%。

ex.en: Trump is acting in Russia's interests.
ex.zh: 川普的所作所為符合俄羅斯的利益。

ex.en: It's in your best interest to accept the offer.
ex.zh: 接受這個提議對你最有利。

ex.en: You can pay for the laptop in 12 monthly installments.
ex.zh: 這台筆電可以分 12 期每月付款。

ex.en: I paid the last installment yesterday.
ex.zh: 我昨天付了最後一期。

ex.en: The final installment of the series comes out next year.
ex.zh: 這個系列的最後一集明年推出。

ex.en: The story will be published in three installments.
ex.zh: 這個故事會分三期刊出。

ex.en: We take inventory at the end of every month.
ex.zh: 我們每個月底盤點庫存。

ex.en: Our inventory of winter coats is running low.
ex.zh: 我們的冬季外套庫存快不夠了。

ex.en: The finance director interjected to correct the cost estimate.
ex.zh: 財務主管插話更正成本估算。

ex.en: Please do not interject while the interpreter is speaking.
ex.zh: 口譯員發言時請不要插話。

ex.en: The retailer buys cleaning supplies in bulk.
ex.zh: 這家零售商大量採購清潔用品。

ex.en: Customers can order these parts in bulk.
ex.zh: 顧客可以批量訂購這些零件。

ex.en: The income statement reports revenue and expenses.
ex.zh: 損益表列出營收與支出。

ex.en: Please send me the income statement for last quarter.
ex.zh: 請把上一季的損益表寄給我。

ex.en: Following the company’s insolvency, the court appointed an administrator.
ex.zh: 公司無力償債後，法院指派了一名管理人。

ex.en: The report warned that falling sales could lead to insolvency.
ex.zh: 報告警告，銷售下滑可能導致公司無力償債。

intuitive.zh: 直覺易用的；容易理解的

ex.en: The dashboard has an intuitive design.
ex.zh: 這個儀表板的設計很直覺。

ex.en: Most users find the controls intuitive.
ex.zh: 大多數使用者都覺得這些控制項容易理解。

interoperability.zh: 互通性；系統間的相容能力

ex.en: Interoperability allows the two systems to share data.
ex.zh: 互通性讓兩套系統可以交換資料。

ex.en: The standard improves interoperability between devices.
ex.zh: 這項標準提升了裝置之間的互通性。

ex.en: The new insulation keeps the upper floor cooler in summer.
ex.zh: 新的隔熱材料讓頂樓夏天更涼爽。

ex.en: An electrician checked the insulation around the exposed wires.
ex.zh: 電工檢查了裸露電線周圍的絕緣層。

ex.en: He developed insomnia while adjusting to the night shift.
ex.zh: 他適應夜班期間開始失眠。

ex.en: The specialist suggested keeping a sleep diary to manage insomnia.
ex.zh: 專科醫師建議記錄睡眠日誌來改善失眠。

ex.en: The insured must report the damage within thirty days.
ex.zh: 被保險人必須在三十天內通報損害。

ex.en: Each insured receives a copy of the updated policy.
ex.zh: 每位被保險人都會收到更新後的保單副本。

ex.en: The contract provides indemnity for losses caused by the supplier.
ex.zh: 合約規定供應商造成損失時須予以賠償。

ex.en: The policy includes indemnity for eligible legal expenses.
ex.zh: 這份保單包含符合條件的法律費用補償。

ex.en: She used part of her inheritance to pay off the mortgage.
ex.zh: 她用部分遺產清償房貸。

ex.en: The lawyer explained how the inheritance would be divided.
ex.zh: 律師說明了遺產的分配方式。

ex.en: Visitors should use the intercom to contact the front desk.
ex.zh: 訪客請使用對講機聯絡櫃檯。

ex.en: The intercom lets staff communicate between floors.
ex.zh: 員工可以透過內線通話系統跨樓層聯絡。

ex.en: The audience returned to their seats before intermission ended.
ex.zh: 中場休息結束前，觀眾都回到座位。

ex.en: Refreshments are available in the lobby during intermission.
ex.zh: 幕間休息時，大廳有提供茶點。

ex.en: Turn right at the next intersection.
ex.zh: 請在下一個十字路口右轉。

ex.en: This intersection is dangerous.
ex.zh: 這個十字路口很危險。

ex.en: You can get there by crossing the street at the second intersection.
ex.zh: 你在第二個路口過馬路就到了。

ex.en: Sir, can we quickly inspect your luggage please?
ex.zh: 先生，我們可以檢查一下您的行李嗎？

ex.en: "I need to inspect the wound," said the doctor.
ex.zh: 醫生說：「我需要檢查一下傷口。」

ex.en: The cadres inspected our school.
ex.zh: 幹部們來視察我們學校。

ex.en: Tom was badly injured in a traffic accident.
ex.zh: 湯姆在交通意外中受了重傷。

ex.en: My brother was injured in the car accident.
ex.zh: 我哥在車禍中受傷了。

ex.en: He was slightly injured in a traffic accident.
ex.zh: 他在車禍中受了輕傷。

ex.en: The ambulances carried the injured to the nearest hospital.
ex.zh: 救護車把傷者送往了最近的醫院。

ex.en: The injured were taken to three different hospitals.
ex.zh: 傷者被送往三家不同的醫院。

ex.en: Why did you buy travel insurance?
ex.zh: 你為什麼買了旅遊保險？

ex.en: Can I use my medical insurance?
ex.zh: 我可以使用我的醫療保險嗎？

ex.en: Please mail this form to your insurance company.
ex.zh: 請把這份表格寄給您的保險公司。

ex.en: The number of tourists has increased greatly in recent years.
ex.zh: 近年來觀光客人數大幅增加。

ex.en: The number of people who go abroad has been increasing.
ex.zh: 出國的人數一直在增加。

ex.en: The number of cars driven in the city has increased.
ex.zh: 在城市裡行駛的車輛數量增加了。

ex.en: There has been a 10% increase in sales.
ex.zh: 銷售額成長了 10%。

ex.en: The price increase surprised many customers.
ex.zh: 漲價讓很多顧客感到意外。

ex.en: Please send the invoice to our accounting department.
ex.zh: 請把請款單寄給我們的會計部。

ex.en: The invoice must be paid within 30 days.
ex.zh: 這張請款單須在 30 天內付清。

ex.en: We will invoice you at the end of the month.
ex.zh: 我們會在月底開請款單給您。

ex.en: The supplier invoiced us twice by mistake.
ex.zh: 供應商不小心向我們請了兩次款。

ex.en: Have you got that in stock?
ex.zh: 你們有現貨嗎？

ex.en: Sorry, that size is not in stock right now.
ex.zh: 抱歉，那個尺寸目前沒有庫存。

ex.en: Tomorrow we will welcome the first intern.
ex.zh: 明天我們會迎來第一位實習生。

ex.en: Tom is just an intern.
ex.zh: 湯姆只不過是實習生。

ex.en: For media inquiries, please contact your local communications or marketing representative.
ex.zh: 媒體詢問請洽當地的公關或行銷代表。

ex.en: Thank you for your inquiry about our products.
ex.zh: 感謝您詢問我們的產品。

ex.en: We made inquiries into his past.
ex.zh: 我們對他的過去進行了調查。

ex.en: The government has opened an inquiry into the accident.
ex.zh: 政府已經對這起事故展開調查。

ex.en: Please inform me of any changes in the situation.
ex.zh: 如果情況有任何變化，請務必通知我。

ex.en: Please inform me of the plan ahead of time.
ex.zh: 請你事先把計劃告訴我。

ex.en: Please keep me informed.
ex.zh: 請隨時通知我最新狀況。

ex.en: Your voice is almost inaudible. Can you move closer to the mic?
ex.zh: 你的聲音幾乎聽不到，可以靠近麥克風一點嗎？

ex.en: He said something inaudible and left the room.
ex.zh: 他小聲說了句聽不清楚的話就離開了房間。

ex.en: I've got my college interview tomorrow. Hopefully I'll pass.
ex.zh: 我明天有大學入學面試，希望能通過。

ex.en: You'll have to play it by ear at the interview.
ex.zh: 面試時你得隨機應變。

ex.en: The interviewer introduces the topic of the interview.
ex.zh: 採訪者先介紹了這次訪問的主題。

ex.en: The singer gave an interview to a local newspaper.
ex.zh: 那位歌手接受了當地報紙的採訪。

ex.en: I interviewed him.
ex.zh: 我採訪了他。

ex.en: Tom is being interviewed by Mary.
ex.zh: 湯姆正在接受瑪麗的訪問。
